newsitem.title: USA: Grand Court reduces size of share offering.
newsitem.headline: Grand Court reduces size of share offering.

text.p: Grand Court Lifestyles Inc said on Tuesday it had reduced the size of its proposed initial public offering of common and convertible preferred stock.

The company is reducing its offering of senior convertible redeemable preferred stock to 1.5 million from 5 million and its common stock to 1.5 million shares from 2.6 million shares, Grand Court said.
Grand Court said 300,000 shares of common stock are being offered by the selling security holders and the remainder of the shares are offered by the company.
It is anticipated that the initial offering price of both the convertible preferred stock and the common stock will remain at $10.00 per share, the company said.
Proceeds from the offering will fall to $22.5 million instead of the $62 million that was originally anticipated, the company said.
Proceeds will be used to fund development of new adult living communities, Grand Court said.

The company may seek to obtain construction financing from sources that may require lower equity contributions from the developer, engage in refinancings of newly developed communities or issue additional debt to generate funds, Grand Court said.
National Securities Corp of Seattle is the managing underwriter for the offering, the company said.
